description: Pre-execution market regime for BTC, ETH and SOL against USD in one batched answer: per asset a 4-venue composite mid (Coinbase, Kraken, Bitstamp, Binance.us), venue spread, 15 s and 60 s fast-vs-slow lead-lag in bps, Coinbase-only 60-minute Parkinson realized volatility (null when Coinbase bars are unavailable, never a thinner venue), and a calm, elevated or storm regime with a halt flag and a recommended edge add-on; partial (and never charged) when any asset has fewer than two venues
name: crypto__multi_regime
